Title: AmbientDeck: Smart TV Wall
Short Description: Turn idle Smart TVs and tablets into a modular 4K ambient dashboard.
Full Description:
AmbientDeck transforms idle Android TV screens, living room displays, tablets, and kiosks into a sleek, modular ambient dashboard. Designed specifically for TV remotes and touchscreen kiosks, AmbientDeck delivers real-time information in a cinematic visual format.

KEY FEATURES

• Live 4K Artwork Canvas
Curated collections of scenic landscapes, cyberpunk cityscapes, deep space astrophotography, modern architecture, and fine art. Smooth crossfade transitions bring museum-quality visuals to your living room.

• Atmospheric Weather & Air Quality
Real-time weather telemetry powered by Open-Meteo. View temperatures, humidity, wind velocity, and official US and European Air Quality Index (AQI) ratings along with a comprehensive 7-day outlook.

• Live Overhead Flight Radar
Track active commercial flights cruising through your local airspace in real time. An animated radar scope displays nearby aircraft with live callsigns, altitude, groundspeed, and heading powered by OpenSky Network.

• Real-Time Crypto Tickers
Keep an eye on market trends with live 24-hour cryptocurrency price tickers and dynamic sparklines powered by Binance public feeds.

• Today in History
Discover historical milestones, notable anniversaries, and world events corresponding to today's date, curated via MuffinLabs.

• Burn-in Mitigation for OLED Screens
Integrated pixel drift shifting gently repositions dashboard elements at subtle intervals, protecting OLED and AMOLED television panels during continuous operation.

• Modular Layouts & Units
Switch between Cinematic Wall, Multi-Panel Kiosk, and Minimal Zen Clock modes. Customize Celsius or Fahrenheit, knots or mph, feet or meters, and select your location from worldwide hubs or custom GPS coordinates.

Built for Android TV with D-pad navigation, Leanback launcher banner support, and full touch compatibility.
